---
title: "Titanic survival report (R Markdown badge baseline)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
path <- list.files("/kaggle/input", pattern = "^train.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
train <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Survival rate by class

```{r}
train %>% group_by(Pclass) %>% summarise(survival = mean(Survived), n = n())
```

## A simple logistic regression

```{r}
fit <- glm(Survived ~ Sex + Pclass + Age, data = train, family = binomial)
summary(fit)
```
